context: A family squabble over picky eating at dinner
purpose: Teach: 悪かっ/むずかしい/親戚/正常/パーティ/イヤ/引退/衛生

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔、また野菜残してるの？イヤって顔しないでよ。
lines.en: Sho, you're leaving vegetables again? Don't make that disgusted face.
lines.style: Mom firm but tired, frowning across the dinner table at her son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: だってピーマンむずかしいんだもん。ぜったいイヤ！
lines.en: But peppers are too hard for me. No way!
lines.style: Child whining, pushing plate away, drawing out the vowels stubbornly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ご飯の前に手を洗うのと同じで、好き嫌いを減らすのも衛生と健康のためなのよ。
lines.en: Just like washing your hands before meals, cutting down on picky eating is for hygiene and health.
lines.style: Mom gesturing toward his hands, then the plate, voice patient but instructive.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: じゃあピーマン、もう引退でいいじゃん！パパだって会社引退するんでしょ？
lines.en: Then peppers can just retire! Dad's gonna retire from his job someday too, right?
lines.style: Child making a cheeky joke, kicking his legs under the table, grinning.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 来週、親戚のパーティがあるのよ。みんなの前で野菜イヤって言える？
lines.en: We have a relatives' party next week. Could you say 'I hate vegetables' in front of everyone?
lines.style: Mom raising an eyebrow, voice rising with maternal warning tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 親戚のパーティなんて行きたくない…おばちゃん怖いし。
lines.en: I don't want to go to the relatives' party... Auntie's scary.
lines.style: Child mumbling into chest, slumping down in chair dramatically.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 好き嫌いが多いのは正常な成長の一部だけど、少しずつ慣れていこうね。さっき強く言って悪かったわ。
lines.en: Being picky is a normal part of growing up, but let's get used to it little by little. Sorry for being harsh just now.
lines.style: Mom softening her voice, reaching out to pat his shoulder warmly with a sigh.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: …ひと口だけね。ママ、悪かったって言うのずるいよ、断れないじゃん。
lines.en: ...Just one bite. Mom, saying sorry like that is sneaky, I can't refuse.
lines.style: Child reluctantly picking up fork, half-smiling at being outmaneuvered by mom.
